technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring for Apache Kafka to implement Kafka source offset control and partition pre-allocation.
Implement reactor-stream processor module using Project Reactor for time-window operations.
Use Spring Integration for microbatching capability with configurable batch intervals.
Leverage existing Spring XD message bus architecture for partition pre-allocation between nodes.
Use Spring Boot for simplified configuration and embedded server deployment.
Implement Spark integration as a proof-of-concept using Spark Streaming library.
Use Wiki-based documentation system for user configuration guides.
Implement performance testing infrastructure using Rackspace cloud resources.
assumptions: Development team has existing knowledge of Spring ecosystem and Kafka.
Existing Spring XD codebase can be extended without major architectural changes.
Wiki documentation system is already in place or can be quickly set up.
Rackspace account and infrastructure access is available for performance testing.
Spark POC will be limited in scope to core streaming functionality.
All modules will follow existing Spring XD module patterns and conventions.
Testing environments for Kafka and Spark are available or can be provisioned quickly.

activities.activity_description: Create and configure wiki documentation for new sources, sinks, processors, and features
Implement starting offset control for Kafka source modules with stream deployment
Implement partition pre-allocation between Kafka source modules during stream deployment
Implement partition pre-allocation in Spring XD message bus between nodes
Investigate Spark integration, develop proof-of-concept, and identify design approach
Implement reactor-stream processor module with time-window operations support
Implement microbatching capability with configurable batch intervals for performance
Set up performance testing infrastructure on Rackspace for Kafka baselines and XD use cases
Perform integration testing across all implemented features and modules
